positions.name: ConsentConstrainedRecordingRetentionAdjustment
positions.frame: When participant consent renewal falls below threshold, how does retention adjust between raw field recordings and permanent archival transcripts?
positions.why: Binds the administrative shortening of the raw recording retention period (src-1) directly to the empirical failure of participant consent renewals beyond the first year (src-2), while preserving the permanent retention status of archival transcripts against the shortened lifespan of raw audio (src-3).
